paragraphs.text: Captain Rex Nebula is a human employee who pilots Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun through the multiverse.

Rex Nebula is the self-proclaimed "greatest captain in the universe." He is bombastic and thinks very highly of himself and his piloting skills, but is a terrible pilot. Rex is not the most thoughtful of captains, often parking where he shouldn't, including near black holes. No one knows where Myra found him, but he's been around a long time. He was once a very talented fighter pilot, but those skills do not translate to flying a giant space station.

Rex is responsible for the destruction of Blorb-12 , the home-world of the Blorbians and Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop . Due to their history, Nebula and the Ambassador have a friendly rivalry, sometimes even getting dinner together. His penchant for causing destructive crashes has coined the phrase "pulling a Nebula."
